messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The relation 'more likely to have' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject group is statistically more prone to having the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has risk factor': The subject condition or event is associated with an increased risk of the factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'have': The subject group of patients has the medical condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'mimics': The subject condition or symptom is similar to or can be mistaken for the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be accompanied by': The subject condition or entity may occur alongside or be associated with the condition specified by the object entity.
